secondFactor.fallbackText: If this wasn't you, change your password straight away and get in touch with whoever runs this site.

enabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is on
enabled.title: Two-factor authentication is on
enabled.body: From now on, signing in with your password will also ask for a code from your authenticator app. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe — they are how you get in if you lose the app.

disabled.subject: Two-factor authentication is off
disabled.title: Two-factor authentication is off
disabled.body: Your account no longer asks for a code when you sign in, and the recovery codes you had have been discarded. You were signed out everywhere else.

disableHeld.subject: Two-factor authentication will be turned off
disableHeld.title: Two-factor authentication will be turned off
disableHeld.body: Two-factor authentication will be turned off on {{date}}. Until then your account still asks for a code when you sign in, and you can cancel it under Security in your settings.

recoveryRegenerated.subject: New recovery codes were made for your account
recoveryRegenerated.title: New recovery codes were made for your account
recoveryRegenerated.body: A new set of recovery codes was made for your account, and the ones you had no longer work. Keep the new ones somewhere safe.

passwordRemoved.subject: Your password was removed
passwordRemoved.title: Your password was removed
passwordRemoved.body: Your account no longer has a password. From now on you sign in with your passkey or your sign-in provider. Keep your recovery codes somewhere safe — they are how you set a password again if you ever need one.
passwordRemoved.fallbackText: If this wasn't you, use one of your recovery codes to set a password straight away and get in touch with whoever runs this site.

passwordChanged.subject: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.title: Your password was changed
passwordChanged.body: The password for your account was just changed. Every other device signed in to your account has been signed out.
passwordChanged.fallbackText: If this wasn't you, reset your password straight away and get in touch with whoever runs this site.

passkey.fallbackText: If this wasn't you, change your password straight away and get in touch with whoever runs this site.

added.subject: A passkey was added to your account
added.title: A passkey was added to your account
added.body: A passkey called {{passkey}} can now be used to sign in to your account. Passkeys live on the device or password manager that made them, so keep the one you used to hand.

removed.subject: A passkey was removed from your account
removed.title: A passkey was removed from your account
removed.body: The passkey called {{passkey}} can no longer be used to sign in. The other ways you sign in are unchanged, and you are still signed in everywhere you were.

removalHeld.subject: Your last passkey will be removed
removalHeld.title: Your last passkey will be removed
removalHeld.body: The passkey called {{passkey}}, the last one on your account, will be removed on {{date}}. Until then it still signs you in, and you can cancel the removal under Security in your settings.

address.fallbackText: If this wasn't you, sign in and check the addresses on your account straight away, and get in touch with whoever runs this site.

removalHeld.title: An address will be removed from your account
removalHeld.body: {{address}} will be removed from your account on {{date}}. Until then it still signs you in, and you can cancel the removal under Account in your settings.

accountErased.subject: Your Initiative account has been deleted
accountErased.title: Your account has been deleted
accountErased.body: This is confirmation that the Initiative account at this address has been deleted, along with the personal information held with it.
accountErased.kept: Some things stay, and they no longer name you: work you contributed to a community remains with that community, attributed to a deleted account.
accountErased.unexpected: If you did not ask for this, reply to whoever runs your Initiative server as soon as you can.
accountErased.textBody: Your Initiative account at this address has been deleted, along with the personal information held with it. Work you contributed to a community remains with that community, attributed to a deleted account.

communityDeleted.subject: {{community}} has been deleted
communityDeleted.title: {{community}} has been deleted
communityDeleted.body: The community {{community}} has been deleted. Its members no longer see it, and nothing in it can be reached.
communityDeleted.recoverable: Nothing has been destroyed yet. Until {{date}}, whoever runs this server can put it back exactly as it was — ask them if this was not meant to happen.
communityDeleted.recoverableNoDate: Nothing has been destroyed. Whoever runs this server can put it back exactly as it was — ask them if this was not meant to happen.
communityDeleted.textBody: The community {{community}} has been deleted. Its members no longer see it. Nothing has been destroyed yet, and whoever runs this server can put it back.

communityOnHold.subject: {{community}} is on hold
communityOnHold.title: {{community}} is on hold
communityOnHold.body: {{community}} is on hold, so nobody can open it for now — its members and its administrators alike. Nothing in it has been changed or removed.
communityOnHold.bodyDeleting: {{community}} is on hold and will be deleted on {{date}} unless its plan is restored. Until then nobody can open it — its members and its administrators alike — and nothing in it has been changed or removed.
communityOnHold.bodyDeletingUnlessLifted: {{community}} is on hold and will be deleted on {{date}} unless the hold is lifted. Until then nobody can open it — its members and its administrators alike — and nothing in it has been changed or removed.
communityOnHold.contactNobody: Contact whoever runs this server to sort it out.

communityTrialEnding.subject: {{community}}'s trial ends on {{date}}
communityTrialEnding.title: {{community}}'s trial ends on {{date}}
communityTrialEnding.body: {{community}}'s trial ends on {{date}}. After that its plan continues and is billed to the payment method on file. Check your billing details, or cancel before then if you don't want to continue.

communityTrialEnded.subject: {{community}}'s trial has ended
communityTrialEnded.title: {{community}}'s trial has ended
communityTrialEnded.body: {{community}}'s trial has ended and the community is now read-only. Choose a plan in the billing portal to keep editing. Nothing has been deleted.

communityPauseReminder.subject: {{community}}'s plan is paused until you resume it
communityPauseReminder.title: {{community}}'s plan is paused
communityPauseReminder.body: {{community}}'s plan is paused. Its members can still read and export everything, but nothing new can be added, and nothing is billed. Resume the plan before {{date}} to keep the community: after that it goes on hold, and it is deleted later unless its plan is restored.

communityWelcome.subject: {{community}} is ready
communityWelcome.title: {{community}} is ready
communityWelcome.body: {{community}} is set up and ready for its members. When you're ready, set up its plan in the billing portal.

signInLocked.fallbackText: If this was you, there's nothing else to do. If it wasn't, someone may know your email address. Your password is still safe, but consider signing in with a passkey.

locked.subject: Password sign-in paused on your account
locked.title: Password sign-in paused
locked.body: Someone entered the wrong password or code for your account 5 times, so signing in with a password or code is turned off for {{minutes}} minutes. Passkeys still work, and you stay signed in where you already are. To turn it back on now, reset your password with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.

lockedHours.subject: Password sign-in paused on your account
lockedHours.title: Password sign-in paused
lockedHours.body_one: Wrong passwords or codes kept arriving for your account, so signing in with a password or code is turned off for an hour. Passkeys still work, and you stay signed in where you already are. To turn it back on now, reset your password with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
lockedHours.body_other: Wrong passwords or codes kept arriving for your account, so signing in with a password or code is turned off for {{count}} hours. Passkeys still work, and you stay signed in where you already are. To turn it back on now, reset your password with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.
